أشلل (form I)
# أَشْلَلْ (ʔašlal) /ʔaʃ.lal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# أَشْلُلْ (ʔašlul) /ʔaʃ.lul/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# أُشْلَلْ (ʔušlal) /ʔuʃ.lal/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
